description: Database connection settings. Maps to go.mau.fi/util/dbutil.Config.

type.description: Database engine type. 'sqlite3-fk-wal' is SQLite with foreign keys and WAL mode.

uri.description: Database connection URI (e.g. file:bridge.db?_txlock=immediate or postgres://...).

max_open_conns.description: Maximum number of open database connections.

max_idle_conns.description: Maximum number of idle database connections.

max_conn_idle_time.description: Maximum time a connection can be idle (Go duration, e.g. '30m').

max_conn_lifetime.description: Maximum lifetime of a connection (Go duration, e.g. '1h').
